statement: The function returns a result r and r = true if and only if there exists a sequence b of length len(nums) of i64 values such that (i) b differs from nums at no more than one index, meaning there is at most one j with 0 <= j < len(nums) and b[j] != nums[j], and (ii) b is non-decreasing, meaning for every k with 0 <= k < len(nums)-1, b[k] <= b[k+1].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100000 <= nums[i] <= 100000.

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100000 <= nums[i] <= 100000.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = false.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10000, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100000 <= nums[i] <= 100000, and there exist indices i and j with 0 <= i < j <= len(nums)-2 such that nums[i] > nums[i+1] and nums[j] > nums[j+1].

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r = true and nums is not non-decreasing (that is, there exists k with 0 <= k < len(nums)-1 and nums[k] > nums[k+1]), there is exactly one index i such that 0 <= i < len(nums)-1 and nums[i] > nums[i+1].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100000 <= nums[i] <= 100000.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = true.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10000, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100000 <= nums[i] <= 100000, and for every i with 1 <= i < len(nums)-1, nums[i] <= nums[i+1].

statement: Let i be that unique index. The function returns a result r and r = true if and only if (i = 0 or i = len(nums)-2 or (i >= 1 and nums[i-1] <= nums[i+1]) or (i+2 < len(nums) and nums[i] <= nums[i+2])), with out-of-range terms guarded by the displayed inequalities and otherwise ignored.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 10000, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100000 <= nums[i] <= 100000, and there is exactly one index i with 0 <= i < len(nums)-1 and nums[i] > nums[i+1].
